answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a unique physical trajectory signature, much as marble rolling along a narrow ledge accumulates path-dependent velocity that cannot be cloned without the original launch conditions. Layered staking escrow, wrapped in a velvet of cryptographic commitments, forces new agents to post collateral proportional. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
